ICS 11.120.10AYD 01New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes the requirements and methods of test for Vacha which consists of dried rhizome of Acorus calamus L.; syn. A. aromaticus Gilib. (Family Araceae).2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
